crossRefs.note: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

parallels.note: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Eglah
people.line: David's wife and mother of Ithream

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Ithream
people.line: Son of David, born in Hebron to Eglah.

translations.web: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
translations.bsb: and his sixth was Ithream, by David’s wife Eglah. These sons were born to David in Hebron.
translations.kjv: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
translations.asv: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
